groups.blurb: Explore how AI can support and speed up your design process.
Learn how to build and maintain design systems that scale.
Get your work from design to build without the manual hand-carrying.
Put prompting to work on the research and synthesis you already do.

resources.title: AI features in Figma
resources.why: The AI built into the tool you already use daily, so nothing new has to be installed or learned around it.

resources.title: Midjourney for product design
resources.why: Ninety minutes is enough to know whether image generation belongs in your process at all.

resources.title: AI in UX practice
resources.why: Research-led rather than tool-led, so you can talk about AI in an interview without sounding like a demo.

resources.title: Variables and modes in Figma
resources.why: The fastest way to see tokens working in a file you already know. Start here if you have an hour rather than a weekend.

resources.title: Design tokens and multi-brand theming
resources.why: Covers the multi-brand half this role asks for, which is where your current design-system work stops short.

resources.title: Dev Mode and handoff in Figma
resources.why: Handoff is the part of the gap you can close inside a file you already own, without waiting for a course.

resources.title: DesignOps in practice
resources.why: Names the versioning and release practices the gap flagged, in the vocabulary a hiring manager will use.

resources.title: Prompt engineering guide
resources.why: The primary source rather than someone's summary of it, and short enough to read in one sitting.

resources.title: Prompting for research synthesis
resources.why: Applies prompting to research synthesis, the strongest skill on your snapshot, so it compounds rather than starts from scratch.
